get.description: This is a deprecated endpoint. This endpoint returns the change history for the specified BimModel. The change history is sorted by most recent first.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
The extended view provides what is shown below.
The normal view is the same as the extended view but excludes attribute created_by.
The compact view returns ids only.
The default view is normal.

items.description: A single change history entry, recording one field modification on the parent resource.

id.description: Unique identifier of this change history entry.

column.description: Internal column name of the field that was changed.

readable_column.description: Localized, human-readable name of the field that was changed, translated to the requested locale.

formatted_column.description: Human-readable name of the field that was changed, in the default locale.

old_value.description: Previous value of the field. Null if the field was not previously set.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who made the change.

login.description: Email address (login) of the user who made the change.

name.description: Full name of the user who made the change.

locale.description: Locale preference of the user who made the change. Null if not set.

company_name.description: Name of the company the user belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this change was recorded, in ISO 8601 format.

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/bim_models/%7Bid%7D/change_history?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&view=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
